profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Senior Software Engineer experienced with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs to implement agentic loops and tool calling.

I'm the co-creator of Blueprinter, a major open source developer tool, https://github.com/procore-oss/blueprinter (1.3k stars, 14 million downloads).

Technologies that I work with:
- Anthropic API, OpenAI API, Local LLM
- Agentic Loops, Tool Calls, Function Calls.
- Claude Code, Codex
- Ruby, Ruby on Rails
- Elixir, Phoenix
- Dart, Flutter
- JavaScript, jQuery, AngularJS
- MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis
- TDD/BDD: Minitest, Capybara, Rspec

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:

positions.description:
- Develop Ruby on Rails applications to support Fullscreen Brandworks.
- Obtain statistics from Facebook's and YouTube's API services.
- Scrape data from raw HTML where API services are not available.
- Contributor to the Yt gem: https://github.com/Fullscreen/yt

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed distributed services with multiple RoR and AngularJS applications.
- Integrated SalesForce, HubSpot, and Eloqua into multiple web applications.
- Developed web applications from the ground up with Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, and AngularJS.
- Discerned legacy code and put it to re-use where possible.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Worked on the front and back end development for web applications while cooperating with remote teams.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
Developed a web portal for Asterism's employees and customers. The web portal is a CRM and a co-creation platform allowing employees to manage customers and their product orders, as well as allowing customers to log into the portal and post information on the type of products they have in mind.

Used Ruby on Rails as the backbone of the portal. HTML5, CSS, and some JavaScript were used to develop the top level UI and graphical effects. JSON API was used to obtain information from remote DB.

There was an initial one month deadline to produce a design of the application. By the end of the deadline, not only was the design implemented, but full CRUD, authentication, and authorization was fully implemented.

The internship with Asterism was originally to support the company in enhancing their supply chain operation, but the internship soon turned into web app development to support the company's co-creation process with customers.

positions.title: Supply Chain Analyst
positions.description:
Investigated and created solutions to the engineering department's bottleneck, leading to major changes to improve the department.

Lean manufacturing methodologies such as value stream maps, capacity analysis, and OEE analysis were used to bring insight into the manufacturing process.

Worked on the implementation of the Continuous Improvement program which included the Plan-Do-Check-Act model.

Worked with Risk Analysis using the Failure Mode and Effects Analysis model.

positions.title: Process Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Researched trends in the Aerospace, Railway and Shipping industries.

Worked on projects relating to Dream It Do It, a state-wide initiative.
